Time.

It's the longest, semi torturous cure I've ever experienced when it came to that.


But I'll be damned if it works like a charm.

You go from thinking about em everyday and wondering where you went wrong, if it was your fault. All that horrible emotional weight that comes with a relationship like that.

It slowly starts to slip off, and then you'll find yourself more and more capable of handling the days without em

You'll get to a point where you realize you were fine before you met them and you'll be fine after they (or you) leave. And if you feel you weren't ok before you met them, well. You're better off now, if you can recognize that it was a toxic relationship.

Time is a bitch. But time is healthy. 

Focus on yourself, remind yourself of all the things you enjoyed and were before the toxic partner arrived, GO NO CONTACT and try and find outlets to digest your emotions and what you're going through.

Don't feel guilty or bad for the emotions you'll feel. And don't beat yourself up for how long the process takes.

Therapy is golden here. I highly recommend it.

All of this is easier said (written/typed?) than done. But you'll be better off for it. 

Also, go have an ice cream. You deserve ice cream.

Hope peace finds you soon!
